title: Yeasty Aerated Mediterranean Lamb Leg Bake
description: A unique and flavorful dish featuring a lamb leg, yeast, and Mediterranean herbs, perfect for a date-night dinner. This recipe is suitable for vegetarians as long as the yeast is vegan.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the middle position.
Rinse the lamb leg and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the yeast, olive oil, garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the mixture all over the lamb leg, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the lamb leg on a rimmed baking sheet or a cast-iron skillet, bone-side down.

Bake the lamb leg for 20 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 375°F (190°C) and continue baking for another 20-25 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare.
Remove the lamb leg from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Meanwhile, mix the chopped parsley with a squeeze of lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
To serve, slice the lamb leg and serve it with the parsley salad and a side of crusty bread.
Sprinkle a little bit of yeast on top of the lamb leg before baking for an extra-flavorful crust.
Use a meat thermometer to ensure the lamb leg is cooked to a safe internal temperature.
If using a cast-iron skillet, make sure it is preheated in the oven for at least 10 minutes before adding the lamb leg.
For a more golden-brown crust, rub the lamb leg with a little bit of olive oil before baking.
